result.summary: The pedestrian environment is highly hostile due to the complete absence of sidewalks, curbs, or any form of physical separation from vehicular traffic. Pedestrians are forced to walk on the narrow paved shoulder or in the grass, directly adjacent to a two-lane roadway with high-speed characteristics.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Infrastructure
hazards.description: Total absence of sidewalks or protected walkways forces pedestrians to share the travel lane or narrow shoulder with vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the roadway throughout the visible frame

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Dense vegetation on the right side of the curve limits the ability of drivers and pedestrians to see each other around the bend.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway along the curve

interventions.title: Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install a continuous paved sidewalk or multi-use path separated from the roadway by a planting strip or curb.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Trim back overhanging and encroaching vegetation on the inside of the curve to improve sight distance.

interventions.title: Edge Line Narrowing
interventions.description: Narrow the travel lanes to encourage lower speeds and provide a wider paved shoulder for emergency pedestrian use until a sidewalk is built.

result.summary: The environment is entirely devoid of pedestrian infrastructure, consisting of tall, unmaintained vegetation adjacent to an industrial area. There are no sidewalks, crossings, or lighting visible, creating a hostile environment for anyone walking.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is highly hostile, characterized by a complete lack of sidewalks, crosswalks, or street lighting. Pedestrians are forced to walk on the narrow, unpaved shoulder or within the travel lanes of a two-lane roadway bordered by dense vegetation.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Separation
hazards.description: The absence of sidewalks or paved shoulders forces pedestrians to share the travel lane with motor vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both sides of the roadway throughout the visible area.

hazards.name: Restricted Sightlines
hazards.description: Dense vegetation grows right to the edge of the pavement, potentially hiding pedestrians from drivers and vice versa.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and right road edges in the foreground and midground.

hazards.name: Lack of Street Lighting
hazards.description: No street lighting is visible, which significantly increases risk for pedestrians during nighttime or low-light conditions.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install a paved sidewalk or a wide, separated multi-use path to provide a safe space for pedestrians away from vehicle traffic.

interventions.title: Street Lighting Installation
interventions.description: Add overhead street lighting to improve visibility for all road users and enhance safety during dark hours.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Trim back encroaching foliage to improve sightlines and clear space for a dedicated pedestrian walkway.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a complete lack of sidewalks, forcing people to walk on the grass or within the roadway. While traffic calming in the form of a speed hump is present, the absence of dedicated walking infrastructure and potential sightline obstructions from dense vegetation create a high-risk environment for pedestrians.
